name: Monoism
description: Monoism, the True Faith, is the faith of Susur Secundi that worships INEVITA and believes all mass will collapse into black holes.

timeline.summary: The Monoists recite the prayer of gravity together.
timeline.quote: "This is the grace of gravity," someone says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The inevitor strikes the Dawnsire and deploys a cherazad that suspends most of the impact.
timeline.quote: As it strikes the Dawnsire , the inevitor deploys a cyst of altered space, a tactical event horizon: a cherazad.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The boarding party leaps for the inner hull toward the Sunstar defenders.
timeline.quote: Everyone casts their center of mass forward.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoist boarders overwhelm the Sunstar defenders in a short fight.
timeline.quote: Then, it is over. Alpharael barely got to swing his axe.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A puzzler takes sekhar and the resulting microvoid pierces the inner hull, letting the boarders open a hatch.
timeline.quote: One of the puzzlers bellows, "Praise HIM !" and takes sekhar.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Behind the hatch the boarders find a Sunstar basilica and someone begins burning it.
timeline.quote: It's a basilica, a house of the Sunstar faith.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists below pulse gravity waves at the deck, shaking it apart.
timeline.quote: The deck whines under their boots.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Monoist fanatic seizes Haliya's helmet and concusses her at ninety-five gravities.
timeline.quote: The concussion blanks her.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Nacho maps the defenses from Nacha's shot and then hits the monastery being built above Susur Secundi.
timeline.quote: The monastery in construction above Susur Secundi jets violet plasma and lurches in its orbit.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the wounded Hopelight pilot is a Monoist who has stolen the Free Company's fighter.
timeline.quote: That's a Monoist name. In a Sunstar Free Company fighter.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami removes their helmet and invents a cover story as an agent of the Monastery of the True Faith.
timeline.quote: We serve the Monastery of the True Faith at Susur Secundi, which you call Anuki.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company bid with speed to reach Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company are in a bidding war, and they are paying with speed.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle lases the shadow shields of palestars braking too close, and the Monoists kill them.
timeline.quote: A pair of Sunstar patrol ships try to brake too close to Guideline, and Pinnacle shows its teeth

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael broadcasts to the Monoists that he carries a thing sent by INEVITA and asks help reaching the warp.
timeline.quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, kamu-shiku, chosen by the singularity.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The fighting continues around but does not touch the Seriema.
timeline.quote: But the fighting does not touch the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A ceasefire lets both sides crowd toward Infinite Guideline to receive the Endstone and destroy pursuers.
timeline.quote: Under cover of a ceasefire—to retrieve survivors, make repairs, and limp away—both sides crowd in toward Infinite Guideline, waiting to receive the Endstone from the Seriema and destroy its pursuers.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Infinite Guideline springs leaks and loses its aurorae as Monoist mechans dock at punctures.
timeline.quote: Infinite Guideline has just sprung leaks. A lot of leaks.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle's Tactical Corps personnel independently decide to release their violence delegates.
timeline.quote: Release the violence delegates.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle's mechan swarms target the radiators of the faiths' warships.
timeline.quote: Their target is the most vulnerable part of any warship—the radiators.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The hunger from space feeds on both Sunstar and Pinnacle forces but never on Monoists.
timeline.quote: But it does not feed on Monoists.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Monoist gravkill paladin has taken the Seriema.
timeline.quote: The worshippers of INEVITA have taken the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami stabs the Monoist armor in the chest.
timeline.quote: They stab the Monoist right in the chest.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The paladin says the Monoists will aid the Endstone if it goes through the eternity column.
timeline.quote: The Endstone has come here, to the eternity column. If it wishes to go through the eternity column, then it will, and we will aid it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball of alabile, apparently killed by Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball, like crushed foil.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya traveled to Sothera aboard the Dawnsire, which will reignite the supervoid.
timeline.quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire , a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael has strange dreams since his sister dove into the supervoid.
timeline.quote: He has been plagued by strange dreams ever since his sister embraced eternity and dove into the supervoid.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Xu-Ifit's wife is frozen by time dilation after plunging into the supervoid.
timeline.quote: Ten years ago, Xu-Ifit's wife made the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid but was caught in a sudden gravitational anomaly, leaving her frozen in place by time dilation.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Xu-Ifit experiments on Monoist acolytes to perfect a way to save her wife.
timeline.quote: she experiments on Monoist acolytes, testing their survivability through dangerous missions before sending them to take the plunge into the Sotheran supervoid.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: In ancient times the star Susur collapses into a supervoid, later called Point Prime, and the Susurians found Monoism.
timeline.quote: In ancient times, the star Susur collapsed into a supervoid, later called Point Prime.

citation.text: "Monasteriat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Purael is one of the True Faith heading to the Next Eternity.
relations.quote: so she is going ahead to paradise to enforce discipline and make sure it is ready for the rest of the True Faith to arrive.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Sami identifies Alpharael as a Monoist.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Xu-Ifit is a Monoist surgeon at Susur Secundi.
relations.quote: Xu-Ifit is a surgeon of the Monoist faith, currently stationed at Susur Secundi.

pages_say.description: The faith of Alpharael, believing all futures end in black holes.

pages_say.description: The Monoist forces whose paladins and war armor attack Infinite Guideline but are spared by the elds.

citation.text: "Celestial Palatinate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An ancient unitary faith practiced by multiple species that holds the Immortal Faller approaches every supervoid and INEVITA is the perfect future beyond it.
